name: B10-0558/2025 – § 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text: Expresses concern about the legal and practical barriers to abortion in certain Member States, and calls for dialogue and exchange of best practice to ensure access to SRHR; calls on the Member States to reform their abortion laws and policies to bring them into line with international human rights standards and public health guidelines;
